annotations.title: TIA — compare a block with given SimaticML

description: Exports the block from the project and compares it with the SimaticML you pass (e.g. the file committed in git). Like tia_export_block, this may compile an inconsistent block first (export requires consistency), which can regenerate its instance DB; read-mostly, treated as read for agent tool policy. Normalized: ignores BOM, line endings, indentation, blank lines, <Created>, <InstalledProducts> and — unless ignoreFormatting:false — <NewLine/>/<Blank/> formatting tokens (see the result's `ignored` field for the exact list). UIds are renumbered by first appearance across definitions and references: rewiring differs, pure renumbering matches; UId-like text in comments and values is preserved. Returns verdict equal|different and the first differing line. `normalizedSha256` now uses wiring-safe UId canonicalization: stored values may change; recompute comparison baselines. This is the proof that the project contains what was versioned. Maps to GET /plcs/{plc}/blocks/{block}/xml. Engineering version and schema namespaces remain significant; equality is not cross-version import acceptance. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

options.description: ExportOptions used for the project side (default None)

plc.description: PLC software name from tia_plcs.name, not the device station name

xml.description: SimaticML XML to compare against (e.g. the committed file's content)
